brief: Decision D1 (DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-13): unfinished tasks from earlier days move into Today under `Atrasadas · N`; they keep their date and count in ‘pendientes’ and in the Tareas ‘Hoy’ filter; a repeating task shows only its latest missed occurrence (report B, UX-201). packages.title: Listening stops only when you say so
files: a VoiceTaskScreen widget test (new or existing)
brief: Decision D3: listening ends only on Done (UX_REVIEW.md §2 and §6 U1, one folder above the repo; report A U1, UX-104, UX-107, UX-108). This is the pause that stopped the owner's father. The package changes the session and its states on today's capture screen; P35 then turns that screen into a sheet. Keep today's layout: don't polish a page P35 replaces.

U1, native (NativeSpeechBridge.kt:39-46, :112-142). Today one ACTION_RECOGNIZE_SPEECH session ends at the first pause, and ERROR_SPEECH_TIMEOUT / ERROR_NO_MATCH reach Dart as errors. Instead: (a) API 33+: the bridge opens an AudioRecord (16 kHz, mono, PCM 16-bit), writes it into ParcelFileDescriptor.createPipe() from a background thread, and gives the read end to the on-device recognizer with EXTRA_AUDIO_SOURCE, EXTRA_AUDIO_SOURCE_ENCODING, EXTRA_AUDIO_SOURCE_SAMPLING_RATE, EXTRA_AUDIO_SOURCE_CHANNEL_COUNT and EXTRA_SEGMENTED_SESSION = EXTRA_AUDIO_SOURCE. App/test_support/android_speech_probe/ProbeActivity.java:73-131 does exactly this with a file, and App/docs/SPEECH_VALIDATION.md:29-30 records that this configuration produced committed segments in all eight probe cases and ended only at the end of the source. Each pause delivers onSegmentResults, and listening continues. Stopping closes the write end; the recognizer flushes the last segment and calls onEndOfSegmentedSession. Cancel and interruption stop the AudioRecord, close the pipe and cancel the recognizer. (b) Fallback, for API 31–32 or a recognizer that ends the session anyway (onResults, or onError with ERROR_SPEECH_TIMEOUT / ERROR_NO_MATCH, while the user hasn't stopped): start a new session at once and keep appending. Those two errors mean ‘keep waiting’ and never reach Dart. (c) Don't also write the PCM to a WAV (UX_REVIEW §2 point 5): nothing uses it yet. The saved-audio engine (the record plugin path) stays as it is.

Event contract to Dart (native_speech.dart): `ready`, `partial` (the words of the segment in progress), `segment` (committed words), `level`, `ended` (only after stop, cancel or interruption) and `error` only for what can't recover (permission, language not installed, recognizer unavailable). `SpeechEvent.terminal` (native_speech.dart:27-28) becomes `ended` or `error`. The bridge's English messages stay internal: Dart maps them to CaptureProblem codes, as today.

U1, Dart (voice_task_screen.dart). Committed segments append to the words (keep the 4,000-character bound); the current partial shows after them and is replaced as it changes. An automatic end no longer parks the words (:348-353): only the user stopping, Cancel, leaving the app or the time cap end listening. At 60 seconds (today :364 stops at 59 s with `submit: false`) act as if the user had stopped: continue to processing. When the user stops, wait for `ended` a little longer than today's 2 s (up to about 4 s), then continue with the words so far.

UX-104, lifecycle (:574-579, :428-433, :476-481): only `hidden`, `paused` and `detached` mean leaving; `inactive` — the notification shade, system dialogs, the return from the permission dialog — never stops listening. Leaving ends the session (MainActivity.onPause already interrupts it) and keeps every word; the screen is then paused (next point).

UX-108, states. `_busy` (:127) means both ‘starting’ and ‘processing’. Replace it with explicit states: starting → EN `One moment…` / ES `Un momento…` / CA `Un moment…`, with no progress bar; listening → the existing `listeningSeconds` (`Escuchando · 00:07`), shown and timed only from the native `ready` event (NativeSpeechBridge.kt:123 emits it; voice_task_screen.dart:418 ignores it today); paused, after leaving or an interruption with the words kept → EN `Paused` / ES `En pausa` / CA `En pausa`; processing → `puttingPlanTogether`, as today. P35 gives each state its sheet layout and buttons.

UX-107, a microphone blocked for good. In the `permission` handler (NativeSpeechBridge.kt:52-61), when the request comes back denied and shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale(RECORD_AUDIO) is false, return a distinct ‘blocked’ result; a first, ordinary denial keeps today's `captureMicrophone` text. The screen then shows, by the mic: EN `Microphone is off for TaskFlow. Turn it on in Settings, or type instead.` with `Open Settings` / ES `El micrófono está desactivado para TaskFlow. Actívalo en Ajustes o escribe.` with `Abrir Ajustes` / CA `El micròfon està desactivat per a TaskFlow. Activa’l a Configuració o escriu.` with `Obre Configuració`. The button calls permission_handler's openAppSettings() (as notification_settings_screen.dart:190 does). When the app resumes, check again and start listening if it is now granted.

Keep P1's snackbar handling. Don't touch: the layout and buttons (P35), the options and the Task/Note chips (P34, P35), error wording (P40), the saved-audio upload. No APK can be built in this loop: keep the Kotlin self-contained and obviously correct, and list what needs a phone.

Don't touch: P33's session, its states and endpointing, any UI.

brief: Decision D3: ‘Guardar tal cual’ appears when the AI is slow or fails (UX_REVIEW §3.2 and §3.5; report A U7 and UX-103). Today the sheet waits up to 100 s (api_client.dart:335), and errors can show raw English server text (capture_messages.dart:35 falls back to the raw value).

(3) `Guardar tal cual` builds the result with P38's local helper (the parser's date applied) and saves it at once through the normal save, so P37's landing and `Deshacer` apply. An answer from the assistant that arrives afterwards is ignored: the capture is already saved, and CaptureProcessor must not treat that as an error. (4) Saved audio with no words can't be saved as written: there the button isn't offered.

UX-103, errors in plain words, under the status line. (1) capture_messages.dart:35: unknown values are never shown as they are; use EN `That didn't work. Your words are saved here — try again.` / ES `No ha funcionado. Tus palabras siguen aquí; inténtalo de nuevo.` / CA `No ha funcionat. Les teves paraules continuen aquí; torna-ho a provar.` Map HTTP 400, 404 and 422 explicitly in capture_problem.dart:62-93, and keep api_client.dart:277-293's `field: message` text away from capture. (2) Server unreachable, a 5xx or a timeout: EN `Couldn't reach the assistant — your words are kept.` / ES `No he podido contactar con el asistente; tus palabras se conservan.` / CA `No he pogut contactar amb l’assistent; les teves paraules es conserven.` (3) `captureOffline`: EN `No internet. Your words are saved — try again when you're online.` / ES `Sin conexión. Tus palabras están guardadas; inténtalo cuando tengas internet.` / CA `Sense connexió. Les teves paraules estan desades; torna-ho a provar quan tinguis internet.` (4) Short or silent audio (the server's 422 and `captureNoSpeech`): EN `I didn't catch that. Tap Continue and try again.` / ES `No te he entendido. Toca Seguir y vuelve a intentarlo.` / CA `No t’he entès. Toca Continua i torna-ho a provar.` (report A's text names the mic, which the sheet no longer has; `Seguir` is P35's button). (5) `captureSpeechStopped`: EN `Listening stopped. Tap Continue to keep talking, or type.` / ES `Se ha dejado de escuchar. Toca Seguir para continuar o escribe.` / CA `S’ha deixat d’escoltar. Toca Continua per seguir o escriu.` (6) `captureAllowance`, the daily limit: EN `You've reached today's limit. Type the task, or try again tomorrow.` / ES `Has llegado al límite de hoy. Escribe la tarea o inténtalo mañana.` / CA `Has arribat al límit d’avui. Escriu la tasca o torna-ho a provar demà.` (7) Stop appending `captureKept` to messages (voice_task_screen.dart:968). packages.title: Delete and Back never lose a task
brief: Decisions D11 and D12 (DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-13): Undo instead of a confirmation (report B, UX-208 and UX-211).

UX-208 (D11). (1) The 🗑 on a task's or a note's detail (task_detail_screen.dart:30-69) deletes at once: no dialog; the screen closes and shows, through P1's helper, EN `Task deleted` / ES `Tarea eliminada` / CA `Tasca suprimida` — for a note EN `Note deleted` / ES `Nota eliminada` / CA `Nota suprimida` — with the existing `undo` (`Deshacer`). Undo brings it back as it was: date, time, reminder, repeat, steps, notes, attachments and project. (2) Deleting a repeating task removes the whole series, so only that still asks first: the existing `deleteSeriesHelp`, with `keepTask` (`Conservar tarea`) as the filled button and `delete` as a text button in colorScheme.error. (3) How to restore: deleting is a hard delete for the local owner and a soft delete (`is_deleted = 1`, `sync_pending = 1`) for an account (task_database.dart:525-545), and sync may send it within a second. Restore the same row (clear is_deleted, bump the revision, mark it pending), and read Backend/core's task sync code to see how the server treats a task un-deleted after its deletion arrived. If it would refuse it, restore the task locally as a new one instead and report the server side. Don't change Backend/. Back in the edit form (TaskEditor, which P38 made edit-only) keeps the work: with changes, Back saves them and shows the existing `changesSaved` (`Cambios guardados`) with `Deshacer`, which restores the previous version; with no changes, Back just closes. Use a PopScope and the same validation as saving: if the title was emptied, Back shows the field's error and stays. If any path still creates through TaskEditor, Back saves a new item that has a title the same way, and an empty form just closes.

UX-404 (D7c): Ajustes has six rows, ordered by need, all plain ListTiles with chevrons: (1) `Notificaciones` becomes EN `Reminders` / ES `Recordatorios` / CA `Recordatoris` — the row and the screen it opens — first, with its state as the subtitle: EN `On · {lead}` / ES `Activados · {lead}` / CA `Activats · {lead}`, where {lead} is the existing reminderLead phrase for the default (e.g. `10 minutos antes`), or EN `Off` / ES `Desactivados` / CA `Desactivats`; (2) Idioma, the existing LanguageSelector as a row; (3) Apariencia (below); (4) Cuenta, the existing account row with the email; (5) TaskFlow Pro; (6) EN `Other settings` / ES `Otros ajustes` / CA `Altres opcions` (report D's names), a new screen.

Otros ajustes holds, in this order: Hora y región; Calendarios del teléfono; the home-screen mic button, renamed EN `Mic button on your home screen` / ES `Botón de dictar en la pantalla de inicio` / CA `Botó de dictar a la pantalla d’inici` (it keeps P1's instructions sheet); Exportar e importar; Licencias as a row, not a centred text button; and at the bottom a small version line, EN `TaskFlow {version}` / ES `TaskFlow {version}` / CA `TaskFlow {version}`, with the version and build from package_info_plus (already a dependency), e.g. `TaskFlow 1.0.5 (4007)`. P34 adds a Voz row here later.

`Tareas completadas` leaves Settings; it stays on Tareas (the ✓ at home_screen.dart:96-101). Delete the `A TU GUSTO` eyebrow (`welcomeSettings`), the `Ajustes` headline that repeats the app bar (settings_screen.dart:24-27), the wordmark and tagline at the bottom (`moreClarity`), the section labels `APARIENCIA` and `TU ESPACIO`, and the explanatory subtitles of the moved rows; remove keys left unused.

UX-120 (D13): `Diagnóstico de captura` (settings_screen.dart:262-268) appears only in debug builds (kDebugMode), at the bottom of Otros ajustes. On staging builds (APP_ENV is `staging`, read the way revenuecat_service.dart:43 reads it) a long-press on the version line opens a small sheet with `Diagnóstico de captura` and `Detalles de conexión` (the server URL, apiClientProvider.baseUrl; P44 hides it from Account). In production builds the long-press does nothing.

UX-418 and UX-406 (D5), one place for light and dark. Replace the three theme tiles (settings_screen.dart:37-149) with the Apariencia row: its subtitle is the current choice, and it opens a sheet of full-width radio rows — EN `Light` / `Dark` / `Same as phone`, ES `Claro` / `Oscuro` / `Como el teléfono`, CA `Clar` / `Fosc` / `Com el telèfon`. The default stays ThemeMode.system, so a first run follows the phone. Then remove the sun–moon toggle everywhere else: CustomAppBar's ThemeToggle and its `showAppearance` parameter (custom_app_bar.dart:11, :16, :54, and every `showAppearance:` argument) and the toggle on the sign-in screen (login_screen.dart:208). Delete ThemeToggle (app_components.dart:6) if nothing uses it.

UX-422 (Hora y región): the screen this row opens is titled `Idioma y región` (`regionalSettings`); retitle it `Hora y región`. Remove the second language picker from it. Label the time zone EN `Time zone` / ES `Zona horaria` / CA `Fus horari` (drop ‘de captura’) and update `regionalFormatsHelp` to match. Show time zones as city names — the last part of the IANA id with underscores as spaces, e.g. `America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires` → `Buenos Aires` — while still storing the id. `deviceDefault` (ES `Usar el dispositivo`) becomes EN `Same as phone` / ES `Como el teléfono` / CA `Com el telèfon`. Delete the language sheet's 30-word paragraph (`languageHelp`, language_selector.dart:110-113).

UX-431 (added after trial round 1; seen in passing in verify-trial-r1-C.md): the time-zone filter (regional_settings_screen.dart:155-156 and :169) only lowercases, so once zones show as city names, `Bogotá` doesn't find `Bogota` and `México` doesn't find `Mexico City`. Filter with `matchesSearch` (App/lib/services/text_search.dart), the helper every other search uses, against the city name and the id together.
Don't touch: Account and the Pro screen (P44), the header's Activity icon (P25), the Voz screen (P34).
acceptance: Widget test: Settings has exactly six tappable rows — Recordatorios (`Desactivados` on a fresh account, `Activados · 10 minutos antes` once on), Idioma, Apariencia, Cuenta, TaskFlow Pro and Otros ajustes — with no eyebrow, headline, section label or tagline; `Tareas completadas` isn't in Settings and is still on Tareas.

Widget test: Otros ajustes lists Hora y región, Calendarios del teléfono, Botón de dictar en la pantalla de inicio, Exportar e importar and Licencias, then `TaskFlow {version}`; outside debug builds there is no `Diagnóstico de captura` row.

Widget test: the Hora y región screen is titled `Hora y región`, has no language picker, and lists `Buenos Aires` for America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires.
From Calendar, reminders are two taps away (Ajustes, Recordatorios) without scrolling.

packages.title: Sign-in: only a non-empty password; a used email offers sign-in
brief: UX-484 (verify-b5-r1-D): sign-in mode still applies the 12-character rule meant for new accounts (`login_screen.dart:491-494`). A newcomer who types a short everyday password sees 'Usa al menos 12 caracteres' and never reaches the wrong-credentials error that offers to create an account with that email (UX-402, P17). In sign-in mode, require only a non-empty password. Keep the 12-character rule for creating an account and for setting a new password.

Reviewer's note on the same screen (b5 report): in create mode, the 'email already in use' error tells people to sign in but offers no button. Add the mirror of UX-402: a button that switches to sign-in and keeps the email. Reuse an existing string if one fits; otherwise add one in EN, ES and CA.
acceptance: In sign-in mode, a 6-character password is sent to the server with no 12-character message; a wrong-credentials answer then shows the create-account button, with the email kept.
In create mode, a password under 12 characters is still refused with the existing message.
In create mode, an email-in-use error shows a button that switches to sign-in and keeps the email.
deviceChecks: Against the real server, sign in with an unregistered email and a short password: the error offers to create the account, and creating it asks for 12 characters.

packages.title: Invitations say who sent them
brief: UX-326 (partly fixed in b5 by P14): the invitation review screen and Calendar's invitation card don't say who sent the invitation. The help text, 'Sesión iniciada como' and 'Ahora no' are done; only the sender is missing.

The backend now returns `invited_by_name` (a string, or null) on each pending invitation, from `GET invitations/` (projects: the owner, the only one who can invite) and `GET group-invitations/` (groups: the owner or admin who sent it). Commit bc93848. Parse it wherever pending invitations are parsed (search for `list_name` / `group_name`).

Show it on the review screen's first line and on the Calendar card, for example ES 'Ana te invita a «Casa»', EN 'Ana invited you to "Casa"', CA 'Ana et convida a «Casa»' (follow App/docs/LOCALIZATION.md). When it's null (older group invitations) or not known yet (opened from an emailed link before the list loads), keep today's wording, with no layout jump when the name arrives.
acceptance: With `invited_by_name: 'Ana'`, the review screen and the Calendar card name Ana, in EN, ES and CA.
With `invited_by_name: null`, both keep the current wording.
deviceChecks: With a second account, open an invitation sent by the first: the Calendar card and the review screen name the sender.

packages.title: Quiet endings: deleting a group says so; 'Ahora no' stays quiet
brief: UX-485 (verify-b5-r1-C): deleting a group closes its page without a word. Do what UX-340 did for projects ('Proyecto eliminado', key `projectDeleted`): after the page closes, show 'Grupo eliminado' (EN 'Group deleted', CA 'Grup eliminat') on the screen it lands on.

UX-487 (b5 report, reviewer's note): after 'Ahora no' on the invitation review screen, the stored invitation link is kept on purpose, so Calendar's invitation card can offer it again. But the postponement lives only in memory (`_postponedInvitation`, `main.dart:233-239`), so every cold start reopens the review screen until the user answers. Persist the postponement with the stored link (`invitationLinkProvider`, `App/lib/services/invitation_links.dart:42`). A postponed invitation is then offered only by Calendar's card and never reopens by itself. A newly opened link, including the same invitation opened again from the email, still opens the review screen.
acceptance: Deleting a group from its page lands on the previous screen with a 'Grupo eliminado' message, in EN, ES and CA.
After 'Ahora no', restoring the app from stored state (a fresh ProviderContainer over the same storage) doesn't open the review screen, and Calendar's invitation card still offers that invitation.
Opening an invitation link again after 'Ahora no' opens the review screen.
deviceChecks: Open an invitation link and tap 'Ahora no', then force-stop and reopen the app: it opens on Calendar with the invitation card, not the review screen.
Delete an empty group: 'Grupo eliminado' shows where you land.

packages.title: Time-zone search knows Spanish and Catalan city names
brief: UX-486 (verify-b5-r1-D): time-zone search matches only English tz city names (`regional_settings_screen.dart:164`), so 'Londres', 'Nueva York' or 'Nova York' find nothing. Add a small alias table for the commonly searched zones, about 40 to 60 cities (European capitals, the Americas, major Asian and Oceanian cities), with their Spanish and Catalan names. Match them with the same accent folding UX-431 added. Don't translate the whole tz database, and don't change what the rows display.

Reviewer's notes on the same screen (b5 report): the legacy `US/*` and `Canada/*` aliases make 'Pacific', 'Eastern' and others appear twice. Hide legacy alias zones from the list, but keep an account's stored legacy zone shown as the current one. The `regionalSettingsHelp` ARB key is unused and still says 'zona de captura': remove it from all three ARB files and regenerate.
acceptance: Searching 'Londres', 'Nueva York' and 'Nova York', and their versions without accents, each lists the matching zone.
The list has no `US/*` or `Canada/*` duplicates, and an account whose stored zone is a legacy alias still sees it as the current zone.
`regionalSettingsHelp` is gone from the three ARB files and the analyzer is clean.
